summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce that its board of directors maintained the 13.00% annual dividend rate on its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA) and declared daily cash dividends of $0.0493 per share for July 2026. This is a routine dividend maintenance and declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, or structural change. The filing also provides ROC dividend guidance regarding U.S. federal income tax treatment. No special-situation event is involved.
